metadata.description: Qwen3.8-27B — dense 27B VL model with MTP speculative decoding, native 262K context.

Discounted async tier. Requests are held server-side during peak until a capacity gap opens; billed at a reduced rate. Intended for async agent workloads (overnight research, batch reports, nightly code reviews) that tolerate variable latency. See docs/design/flex-tier.md.
Xiaomi's MOPD upgrade of MiMo-V2.6-Pro, with reduced tool-call repetition. Sparse MoE (1.02T total / 42B active) with native vision, tool calling and optional reasoning. 1M-token context.

Tracking alias: our current large model, currently Kimi K3. We move it to a newer model as our catalog changes, with notice before each move. Behaves exactly like the model it points at: same defaults, same price. See the tracking aliases guide.
Flex tier of nw-large (currently Kimi K3): discounted, best-effort latency (requests may be held under load). Moves with nw-large.
